name: proxied-sitemap-apollo
description: A Next.js application that proxies WordPress sitemaps to a headless site and transforms them with clean URL formatting using Apollo Client.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix ./example-app install && npm run wp:start && npm run db:import
scripts.dev: npm run wp:start && npm run app:dev
scripts.db:import: wp-env run cli -- wp db import /var/www/html/db/database.sql
scripts.db:export: wp-env run cli -- wp db export /var/www/html/db/database.sql
scripts.db:query: wp-env run cli -- wp db query

author: hwptoolkit
